Players Committee card image of [[Prophecy Of The Force]] (original printing), game text: “Deploy on a site. While at a battleground, adds one [Dark Side Force] icon and one [Light Side Force] icon here. Once per turn, if a player just Force drained at a site with total ability > 5, relocate this Effect to that site. Once per game, may retrieve a card with 'Anakin' in title into hand. (Immune to Alter.)”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Light/large/prophecyoftheforce.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
